shell.zsh:
# Template: rendered to ~/.config/zsh/rice-colors.zsh by ~/.config/plasma-rice/rice.py
# ({{name}} = palette colour, {{name.rgb}} = the same as r;g;b). Read by ~/.config/plasma-rice/shell/rice.zsh
# when a shell starts and again at the next prompt after each re-theme, so open shells follow the wallpaper.

# the line being typed: commands in the accent, builtins and keywords in the second accent, strings green,
# paths underlined, options quieter, comments muted, anything unknown red
typeset -gA ZSH_HIGHLIGHT_STYLES
ZSH_HIGHLIGHT_STYLES+=(
    default                         none
    unknown-token                   'fg=#f7768e'
    command                         'fg=#c7ccc8'
    alias                           'fg=#c7ccc8'
    suffix-alias                    'fg=#c7ccc8,underline'
    global-alias                    'fg=#c7ccc8'
    function                        'fg=#c7ccc8'
    hashed-command                  'fg=#c7ccc8'
    arg0                            'fg=#c7ccc8'
    builtin                         'fg=#aeb3ae'
    reserved-word                   'fg=#aeb3ae'
    precommand                      'fg=#aeb3ae,italic'
    commandseparator                'fg=#777c78'
    autodirectory                   'fg=#dfe2e0,underline'
    path                            'fg=#dfe2e0,underline'
    path_prefix                     'fg=#dfe2e0,underline'
    path_pathseparator              'fg=#777c78,underline'
    path_prefix_pathseparator       'fg=#777c78,underline'
    globbing                        'fg=#73daca'
    history-expansion               'fg=#bb9af7'
    single-hyphen-option            'fg=#aeb2af'
    double-hyphen-option            'fg=#aeb2af'
    single-quoted-argument          'fg=#9ece6a'
    double-quoted-argument          'fg=#9ece6a'
    dollar-quoted-argument          'fg=#9ece6a'
    rc-quote                        'fg=#9ece6a'
    dollar-double-quoted-argument   'fg=#7dcfff'
    back-double-quoted-argument     'fg=#7dcfff'
    back-dollar-quoted-argument     'fg=#7dcfff'
    back-quoted-argument            'fg=#bb9af7'
    command-substitution-delimiter  'fg=#bb9af7'
    process-substitution-delimiter  'fg=#bb9af7'
    redirection                     'fg=#ff9e64'
    named-fd                        'fg=#ff9e64'
    numeric-fd                      'fg=#ff9e64'
    assign                          'fg=#dfe2e0'
    comment                         'fg=#777c78,italic'
)
# the grey guess from history
ZSH_AUTOSUGGEST_HIGHLIGHT_STYLE='fg=#777c78'
# ↑/↓ history search: the matched part
HISTORY_SUBSTRING_SEARCH_HIGHLIGHT_FOUND='bg=#2c2e2d,fg=#e3e5e4,bold'
HISTORY_SUBSTRING_SEARCH_HIGHLIGHT_NOT_FOUND='bg=#c6576d,fg=#0d100e,bold'

# fzf (Ctrl+R history, Ctrl+T files, Alt+C folders): the chosen line on the deep accent
export RICE_FZF_COLORS='fg:#aeb2af,fg+:#dfe2e0,bg:-1,bg+:#2c2e2d,gutter:-1,hl:#c7ccc8,hl+:#c7ccc8,query:#dfe2e0,prompt:#c7ccc8,pointer:#c7ccc8,marker:#9ece6a,spinner:#aeb3ae,info:#777c78,header:#777c78,border:#3a3e3b,label:#aeb2af,separator:#3a3e3b,scrollbar:#636764'

# man pages (Oh My Zsh colored-man-pages): headings in the accent, arguments in the second accent,
# the status line and search hits on the deep accent
if (( ${+less_termcap} )); then
    less_termcap[md]=$'\e[1;38;2;199;204;200m'
    less_termcap[mb]=$'\e[1;38;2;247;118;142m'
    less_termcap[us]=$'\e[4;38;2;174;179;174m'
    less_termcap[so]=$'\e[1;38;2;227;229;228;48;2;44;46;45m'

# the shrunken prompt of entered commands (shell/rice.zsh)
typeset -g RICE_TIME='#777c78' RICE_DIR='#aeb2af' RICE_OK='#c7ccc8' RICE_ERR='#f7768e'
starship.toml:
# Template: rendered to ~/.config/starship.toml by ~/.config/plasma-rice/rice.py ({{name}} = palette colour)
# Two-line frame. Left: the jewel (where you are, in the accent: CachyOS's mark, or the git mark and the
# repo's name in bold inside a repo), the git pill (branch, an operation under way, what changed, how far
# from the remote), lines changed, the toolchains of the folder. Right, after the rule: how the last
# command went (exit code or signal, how long it took), background jobs, the clock. The prompt is on the
# line below. Once a command is entered, the frame shrinks to one line (shell/rice.zsh).
# Glyphs are written as escapes (Nerd Font private-use characters don't survive every editor).
"$schema" = 'https://starship.rs/config-schema.json'

add_newline = true
command_timeout = 400
scan_timeout = 20
continuation_prompt = "[ ∙ ](fg:#777c78)"

format = """
[╭─](fg:#636764)\
($username$hostname )\
[](fg:#c7ccc8)$directory[](fg:#c7ccc8)\
( [](fg:#2c2e2d)$git_branch$git_commit$git_state$git_status[](fg:#2c2e2d))\
$git_metrics\
$python$nodejs$bun$deno$rust$golang$java$lua$c$zig$docker_context\
$fill\
$status$cmd_duration$jobs\
$time
[╰─](fg:#636764)$character"""

# only over SSH, or as root (in red)
[username]
style_user = "fg:#aeb3ae"
style_root = "fg:#f7768e bold"
format = "[$user]($style)"

[hostname]
ssh_symbol = ""
format = "[@$hostname](fg:#aeb3ae)"

# the jewel: CachyOS's mark and the path; in a repo the git mark, the repo's name in bold, the path in it
# (no "…/" for what lies above the repo: the mark says where it starts)
[directory]
style = "bg:#c7ccc8 fg:#0d100e"
format = "[ $path]($style)[$read_only]($read_only_style)"
repo_root_style = "bg:#c7ccc8 fg:#0d100e bold"
before_repo_root_style = "bg:#c7ccc8 fg:#0d100e"
repo_root_format = "[\U000f02a2 ]($before_repo_root_style)[$repo_root]($repo_root_style)[$path]($style)[$read_only]($read_only_style)"
read_only = " \U000f033e"
read_only_style = "bg:#c7ccc8 fg:#0d100e"
truncation_length = 3
truncation_symbol = "…/"
truncate_to_repo = true

[directory.substitutions]
"Documents" = "\U000f0219"
"Downloads" = ""
"Music" = "\U000f075a"
"Pictures" = ""

# the git pill: deep accent, the branch in bold; what changed in its own colour
[git_branch]
symbol = "\U000f062c"
format = "[$symbol $branch](bg:#2c2e2d fg:#e3e5e4 bold)"
only_attached = true            # a detached HEAD shows its commit instead
truncation_length = 28
truncation_symbol = "…"

[git_commit]
format = "[\U000f0718 $hash$tag](bg:#2c2e2d fg:#e3e5e4 bold)"
tag_disabled = false
tag_symbol = " \U000f04fc "

[git_state]
format = "[ \U000f062d $state( $progress_current/$progress_total)](bg:#2c2e2d fg:#ff9e64 bold)"
rebase = "rebasing"
merge = "merging"
revert = "reverting"
cherry_pick = "picking"
bisect = "bisecting"
am = "am"
am_or_rebase = "am/rebase"

[git_status]
format = "$all_status$ahead_behind"
conflicted = "[ \U000f0026 $count](bg:#2c2e2d fg:#f7768e bold)"
staged = "[ \U000f012c $count](bg:#2c2e2d fg:#9ece6a)"
modified = "[ \U000f03eb $count](bg:#2c2e2d fg:#e0af68)"
renamed = "[ \U000f0054 $count](bg:#2c2e2d fg:#73daca)"
deleted = "[ \U000f09e7 $count](bg:#2c2e2d fg:#f7768e)"
typechanged = ""
untracked = "[ ?$count](bg:#2c2e2d fg:#aeb2af)"
stashed = "[ \U000f03d7 $count](bg:#2c2e2d fg:#bb9af7)"
ahead = "[ \U000f19b2$count](bg:#2c2e2d fg:#7dcfff)"
behind = "[ \U000f19b3$count](bg:#2c2e2d fg:#ff9e64)"
diverged = "[ \U000f19b2$ahead_count\U000f19b3$behind_count](bg:#2c2e2d fg:#ff9e64)"
up_to_date = ""

[git_metrics]
disabled = false
format = "( [+$added](fg:#7da64f))( [-$deleted](fg:#c6576d))"

# toolchains: quiet, major.minor only
[python]
symbol = ""
format = " [$symbol $version( \U000f0320 $virtualenv)](fg:#777c78)"
version_format = "${major}.${minor}"

[nodejs]
symbol = ""
format = " [$symbol $version](fg:#777c78)"
version_format = "${major}.${minor}"

[bun]
format = " [bun $version](fg:#777c78)"
version_format = "${major}.${minor}"

[deno]
format = " [deno $version](fg:#777c78)"
version_format = "${major}.${minor}"

[rust]
symbol = ""
format = " [$symbol $version](fg:#777c78)"
version_format = "${major}.${minor}"

[golang]
symbol = ""
format = " [$symbol $version](fg:#777c78)"
version_format = "${major}.${minor}"

[java]
symbol = "\U000f0b37"
format = " [$symbol $version](fg:#777c78)"
version_format = "${major}"

[lua]
symbol = "\U000f08b1"
format = " [$symbol $version](fg:#777c78)"
version_format = "${major}.${minor}"

[c]
symbol = "\U000f0671"
format = " [$symbol $name $version](fg:#777c78)"
version_format = "${major}.${minor}"

[zig]
format = " [zig $version](fg:#777c78)"
version_format = "${major}.${minor}"

[docker_context]
symbol = "\U000f0868"
format = " [$symbol $context](fg:#777c78)"

[fill]
symbol = "─"
style = "fg:#2a2c2a"

# right side: the last command's exit code (its icon tells a signal, not found, not executable), how long it took, jobs
[status]
disabled = false
format = " [$symbol$status](fg:#f7768e)"
symbol = "\U000f0156 "
not_executable_symbol = "\U000f0341 "
not_found_symbol = "\U000f02d6 "
sigint_symbol = "\U000f073a "
signal_symbol = "\U000f0241 "
map_symbol = true

[cmd_duration]
min_time = 2000
format = " [\U000f051f $duration](fg:#e0af68)"

[jobs]
symbol = "\U000f08bb "
symbol_threshold = 1
number_threshold = 1
format = " [$symbol$number](fg:#73daca)"

[time]
disabled = false
time_format = "%R"
format = " [](fg:#1a1c1b)[\U000f0954 $time](bg:#1a1c1b fg:#aeb2af)[](fg:#1a1c1b)"

[character]
success_symbol = "[❯](bold fg:#c7ccc8)"
error_symbol = "[❯](bold fg:#f7768e)"
vimcmd_symbol = "[❮](bold fg:#aeb3ae)"
